verdict.rationale: Convex is a managed reactive database (cloud deployments, no setup, tables auto-created) with client SDKs for React/React Native and server-side functions (queries/mutations/actions) plus HTTP API for external read/write access, and CLI/dev workflow support. missing for 10: explicit named list of all client SDKs (e.g. mobile/other languages) and independent hands-on confirmation of read/write from a client app beyond docs.
